course_name: 單元操作與輸送現象(三)
outline:
The course introduces the basic concepts of mass transfer and diffusion, and the common unit operation in chemical engineering.

All courses will be recorded and documented in the Youtube Playlist:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL8heLgO8UqyP3-fgGn_vPmWE1LWpPKyMM
schedule:
Introduction (1 wk)
Mass transfer: basic concepts and the theories (2 wks)
Distillation (4 wks)
Introduce Aspen Plus Software (1wk)
Distillation in Aspen Plus (4 wks)
Other unit operations in chemical engineering (2 wks)
Unit operations in Aspen Plus (2 wks)
Diffusion (1 wk)
assessment:
Final exam 100%
Class anticipation -- minus 10 points per absence
